camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise MountTableToCategory --region cn-hangzhou --CategoryId 123 --TableName order_info --CategoryPath '业务域/交易/订单' --CreateMissingCategory false --DbId 1000 --Tid 3000 --ParentCategoryId 100
description_en: Manually mounts a table to a specified business folder to correct an incorrect folder mounting. When Replace is set to true, existing folder relationships of the table are unbound first (remount)
description_zh: 手动把表挂载到指定业务目录，用于修正错误的目录挂载；Replace=true 时先解绑该表其它已有目录关系（改挂）
name: MountTableToCategory

parameters.help_en: The database ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to query the database ID
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile icon in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target leaf folder. Specify either this parameter or CategoryPath (this parameter takes priority). You can query the ID by calling ListAssetCategories. If neither this parameter nor CategoryPath is specified, the operation only unbinds the existing folder of the table
parameters.help_zh: 目标叶子目录 ID，与 CategoryPath 二选一（优先生效），可通过 ListAssetCategories 查询；与 CategoryPath 都不传时仅解绑该表现有目录
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The path of the target folder (levels separated by /). The path locates existing folders level by level, with a maximum depth of 4 levels. The final folder must be a leaf folder
parameters.help_zh: 目标目录路径（层级用 / 分隔），逐层定位已有目录，最深 4 层；最终目录必须是叶子目录
parameters.name: category_path

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent folder from which CategoryPath starts. Leave empty to start from the root folder
parameters.help_zh: CategoryPath 的起始父目录 ID，留空表示从根目录开始
parameters.name: parent_category_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to create folders level by level if the folder specified by CategoryPath does not exist. Default value: false, which returns a 404 error to prevent accidental folder creation from an incorrect path
parameters.help_zh: CategoryPath 对应目录不存在时是否逐层创建，默认 false 直接报 404，避免误传路径凭空造目录
parameters.name: create_missing_category
